summary: The MCP execution-environment.yml uses an ee-minimal-rhel9 base, package_manager_path /usr/bin/microdnf, the collection tarballs in additional_build_files and an append_final step running the install playbook; build with ansible-builder build -t my-mcp-ee:latest.
questions: execution-environment.yml example for an MCP server
How do I run a playbook during an ansible-builder build?
Which package_manager_path should I use for ee-minimal-rhel9?

answer_card.title: Build an execution environment with a custom MCP server
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
version: 3
images:
  base_image:
    name: registry.redhat.io/ansible-automation-platform-25/ee-minimal-rhel9:latest
dependencies:
  galaxy: requirements.yml
options:
  package_manager_path: /usr/bin/microdnf
additional_build_files:
  - src: ansible-mcp_builder-1.0.3.tar.gz
    dest: configs
  - src: myorg-mcp_cfn-1.0.0.tar.gz
    dest: configs
additional_build_steps:
  append_final: |
    RUN ansible-playbook myorg.mcp_cfn.install_cfn_mcp
```
```bash
ansible-builder build -t my-mcp-ee:latest -f execution-environment.yml -v 3
```
